Q: Rearranging information from existing data frame into new data frame A:

I'm glad you already found an answer but since you are asking for advice, here are some tips.

First, when posting data use dput(head(df)). Like this we will have an exact copy of your data set's first rows. There are two problems with the way you posted, the column names (<5, etc) and the character data with spaces (column Spp). Both will force us to manually edit the data before reading it into an R session.

Second, the original column names do not match the column names in the posted solution. This further forces us to manually edit one of the original column names or the vector of column names in your solution.

Finally, you can greatly simplify your solution if you select variables that match a pattern instead of listing them all.
This is better:

df %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("\\d.*cm"), 
    names_to = "length", 
    values_to = "abundance"
  )

Explanation:

  • "\\d" matches a single digit;
  • ".*" any character any number of times, could be zero times;
  • "cm" matches the string "cm" literally.

All put together, "\\d.*cm" matches one digit followed by anything (could be more digits) followed by "cm".

Q: Compute percentage of a variable per group of another in one line with collapse A:

My first thought would be a very basic

TRA(fsum(X$area, X$group), fsum(X$area), '%')

where X is your data.

       A        B        C 
29.26829 21.95122 48.78049

we can dabble a bit to obtain the exact same structure

> df %>% fgroup_by(group) %>% fsummarise(area = fsum(area)) %>% fmutate(pct = area / fsum(area) * 100)
  group area      pct
1     A   60 29.26829
2     B   45 21.95122
3     C  100 48.78049

Let me know, if you are looking for the exact same structure. Note, you can use |> as your pipe.

Q: How to find name matches exact, partial or no match from two list A:

For each element of chknm use which/flike to find index of the first substring match in nmlist and then use fcase to set match. Finally ensure that the order in which the columns appear is as in dtout and compare.

library(data.table)

dt2 <- dt2[, index := which(dt1$nmlist %flike% chknm)[1], by = .I ##
  ][, match := fcase(is.na(index), "nomatch",
                     dt1$nmlist[index] == chknm, "exact",
                     default = "partial"
               )
  ][, .(chknm, match, index)]

fsetequal(dt2, dtout, all = TRUE)
## [1] TRUE

Update

In a comment the poster changed the question so that chknm should be broken into words and if any of those words match then the result is partial if not exact. In that case use this which is the same as the original code except for the new dt2 and the line marked ##.

This assumes that chknm does not contain any characters having special meaning in regular expressions. If it does then replace chknm with stringr::str_escape(chknm) in the line marked ## below.

library(data.table)

dt2 <- data.table(chknm = c('nm1 ln1','nm2','ln3','nm5 ln4'))

dt2 <- dt2[, index := which(dt1$nmlist %like% chartr(" ", "|", chknm))[1], by = .I ##
  ][, match := fcase(is.na(index), "nomatch",
                     dt1$nmlist[index] == chknm, "exact",
                     default = "partial"
               )
  ][, .(chknm, match, index)]

dt2
##      chknm   match index
##     <char>  <char> <int>
## 1: nm1 ln1   exact     1
## 2:     nm2 partial     2
## 3:     ln3 partial     3
## 4: nm5 ln4 partial     4

Note

Input from question:

library (data.table)

dt1 <- data.table(nmlist = c('nm1 ln1','nm2 ln2','nm2 ln3','nm4 ln4'))
dt2 <- data.table(chknm = c('nm1 ln1','nm2','ln3','nm5 ln5'))

dtout <- data.table(chknm = c('nm1 ln1','nm2','ln3','nm5 ln5'),
                    match = c('exact','partial','partial','nomatch'),
                    index = c(1,2,3,NA))

Q: fbexternal-a.akamaihd.net/safe_image.php returns a 1x1 image A:

I also get into a similar problem. My problem is because of the image name has a "space" in it. so it is not appear in the facebook debugger and also in sharing. But i checked with your problem, there is no space in it. so its not the solution for the above problem. It will help another one similar to my issue.

I fixed the issue by replace space with hyphen("-") through coding part. After that i debug the url in facebook debugger, it appears. That means Facebook wont show the image name with "space". But there is no logical reason behind this. Anyway it will help someone.

For more information check this answer posted by Patrick D'appollonio. It helps me.
